inputs.doc: E-047-HEAD · Trains #427's exact stage-2 configuration (206.5M xl144 head, stencil 145, ring spiral, znoise 0.7, grad-clip 128, seed 0, 20k steps) on the z of the FIRST MONTH-BLOCK CODEC — e047a-tpu-60k, the JAX/TPU-trained 40M d_z-64 k_time-7 codec (60k x 512 on family4_na025_pentad_r2; Tier-1 recon audit ACCEPTED 06:30Z: anchor-cell collapse cured, 7.6/17.4%% FVU vs per-bin's 25-112%%). temporal.py adopts k_time/time_block from the checkpoint, so the head's axis is MONTHLY (516 blocks) built entirely from 5-day data — no stride flags (refused on blocks by design). WHY: E-047's registered hypothesis, fusion vs selection — E-045-A2a answered monthly-cadence-from-pentad-z by SELECTING one bin per month and read 0.0721 at 20k; this head consumes the FUSED month. READING: ratio clearly below 0.0721 = fusion beats selection; parity = selection suffices and the block codec's value rides on the roll; the roll follows on any non-catastrophic result. JAX-TRAINED TIER (3b): never pooled with torch numbers; #453 (same recipe, torch, H100) lands ~13:00Z and its head is the cross-framework twin. COST: embed (~516 blocks) + 20k head on the HK box, ~$3-4. RE-DISPATCH of the failed #457: its dispatch copied the A9 template d_z 32 against the block codec d_z 64 and the architecture-contradiction guard refused, correctly, before spending. One field changed. Log anchor e-047.
